summary: the dma, sb16, vga_gfx, vga_text, ps2mouse, ps2kbd and power host tests with 33 faults in private copies of the audio, display, PS/2 and power drivers; the build copies rach2/sys under the work directory and compiles the seven tests, and the test runs each, sb16 also with its arguments frames and setup, and prints its status

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/arch/x86/board.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86/board.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/arch/x86/power.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86/power.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/arch/x86/ps2kbd.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86/ps2kbd.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/arch/x86/ps2mouse.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86/ps2mouse.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/audio/audio_debug.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/audio/audio_debug.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/audio/dma.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/audio/dma.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/audio/sb16.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/audio/sb16.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/display/vga_gfx.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/display/vga_gfx.c; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/display/vga_text.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/display/vga_text.c; for t in dma sb16 vga_gfx vga_text ps2mouse ps2kbd power; do deps=$(sed -n 's/^ \* host-deps://p' tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c | sed "s|rach2/sys/|${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/|g"); ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib tests/host/${t}_hosttest.c $deps -o ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest; done

st=0; for run in dma sb16 sb16:frames sb16:setup vga_gfx vga_text ps2mouse ps2kbd power; do t=${run%%:*}; a=${run#$t}; a=${a#:}; s=0; ${WORK}/${t}_hosttest $a || s=$?; echo "driver-proof: $t${a:+ $a}: status $s"; [ $s -eq 0 ] || st=1; done; exit $st
